decision.reason: The release front door actually installed the dependency-free one-buffer inverse, the preserved historical inverse remained distinct, and 3,070 deterministic/adversarial exact cases covering 5,060,985 logical bytes, delimiter edge values, ragged/empty shapes and up to 45,000 segments reconstructed identically. Four malformed cases were refused as expected.
decision.scope: This establishes release-path semantic equivalence on the tested transform envelope. It does not substitute for complete-product runtime/RSS, reader/recovery/fuzz, native/platform, generalization or strict release authority.
